nodes.summary: For every positive integer $m$, there are infinitely many weakly prime-additive numbers $n$ with $m \mid n$ and length $\kappa_n = 3$ if and only if $8 \nmid m$.

nodes.summary: The number $30$ is a sum of positive powers of three distinct prime divisors of $30$, namely $30 = 2 + 3 + 5^2$.
nodes.title: Thirty is a sum of powers of three of its prime divisors

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $t$, $n$ is a sum of positive powers of $t$ distinct prime divisors of $n$ when there are a set $s$ of $t$ distinct primes, each dividing $n$, and positive integers $e_p$ for $p \in s$ such that $n = \sum_{p \in s} p^{e_p}$.
nodes.title: Sums of powers of distinct prime divisors

nodes.summary: A natural number $n$ is weakly prime-additive if it has at least two distinct prime divisors and is a sum $n = \sum_{p \in s} p^{e_p}$ of positive powers $p^{e_p}$, $e_p \ge 1$, over some set $s$ of distinct prime divisors of $n$.
nodes.title: Weakly prime-additive numbers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $t$, if $n$ is a sum of positive powers of $t$ distinct prime divisors of $n$, then the length $\kappa_n$ of $n$ is at most $t$.
nodes.title: The length is at most the size of any representation

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the length $\kappa_n$ is the least $t$ such that $n$ is a sum of positive powers of $t$ distinct prime divisors of $n$, and $\kappa_n = 0$ when $n$ has no such representation.
nodes.title: Weakly prime-additive length

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
